reviewNotes: Installed payload, not cpanfile runtime dependency labels, determines scope: build/test modules still embedded retain their notices.
Perl core and configured static XS sources retain separate embedded-code notices, including BSD glob, UTF-8 DFA, zlib and MD5 attribution.
Perl MYMALLOC and EBCDIC code are disabled in the qualified WASI build; their implementation headers are excluded.
Dedicated grants, copyright POD sections, legal C comments and explicit author lists referenced by copyright notices are selected by byte range.
Common Apache-2.0 and Artistic-2.0 terms are referenced from canonical full text; LLVM exceptions and original copyright notices remain.
Artistic is selected where Perl dual licensing is offered. Unselected generated GPL alternatives are omitted where separable; original alternatives remain in the broader evidence.
The Unicode 17 UCD and Unicode 13 collation copyright notices are accompanied by Unicode-3.0 and Unicode-DFS-2016 texts.
Host-generated Errno copyright sections are pinned separately. Payload metadata and Config_heavy.pl contents vary by host; all paths and other delivered file hashes are pinned.
Reviewed against both local aarch64 and GitHub x86_64 builds; notice output is identical.
